positions.commentary: The speaker believes large companies like Facebook (Meta) have been mispriced due to investor herding, creating incredible opportunities for investors.
The speaker notes that Amazon's price swings are driven by the expectation cycle of investors loving and falling out of love with the company.
Texas Instruments has appreciated 50% since April lows due to the tariff tantrum, and the speaker highlights the pro-cyclical nature of ratings upgrades as the stock approaches all-time highs.
